title: Super Kudumbam
desc: Arun pretends to be married in order to get a house for rent. He picks Shanthi, an uncouth slum girl, to act as his wife. Eventually, circumstances change and they get actually married.

title: Irandu Mugam
desc: Parthasarathy becomes an MLA with the help of a local leader and dreams of becoming a minister. However, when he makes some corrupt decisions, his secretary steps in to guide him morally.

title: Sonnalthan Kaadhala
desc: Roja, a part-time singer, works at a finance company where her colleague, Murali, is madly in love with her. However, Roja rejects his proposal as she is the sole breadwinner of her large family.

title: Eazhaiyin Sirippil
desc: Kausalya falls in love with a bus driver, Ganesan, working for her father. However, as she strives to navigate her love and wants to marry him, his past is revealed.

title: Ninaithen Vandhai
desc: Gokulan sees a woman in his dream and is determined to find her. Complications arise when he meets the lady of his dreams soon after his father gets him engaged to another woman.
